snippet.description:
This is Minecraft But we're Upgrading SUNMAN Into a GOD In Minecraft! When Steve's body gets transformed into SUNMAN Monsters like the FROST SUNMAN, SUPERNOVA SUNMAN he needs to UPGRADE himself by entering the mysterious portals! Steve needs to learn how to evolve himself to absurd levels so he can use the amazing overpowered upgrade abilities! Can Steve learn all the secrets and abilities of the evolution upgrades, get all the Sun Man upgrades, and upgrade into the ultimate Sunman? This is Upgrading SUNMAN Into a GOD in Minecraft
__

👋🏼 Checkpoint Website: https://checkpointmultiverse.com/
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/checkpoint.yt
❤️ Connect With Us: https://direct.me/checkpointmultiverse

MORE CHECKPOINT ADVENTURES:

‣ MINECRAFT DIMENSION: https://bit.ly/3mKfUOL


Minecraft is an open world game that has no specific goals for the player to accomplish, allowing players a large amount of freedom in choosing how to play the game however, there is an achievement system. The gameplay by default is first person, but players have the option to play in third person mode. The core gameplay revolves around breaking and placing blocks. The game world is essentially composed of rough 3D objects—mainly cubes—that are arranged in a fixed grid pattern and represent different materials, such as dirt, stone, various ores, water, and tree trunks. While players can move freely across the world, objects and items can only be placed at fixed locations relative to the grid. Players can gather these material blocks and place them elsewhere, thus allowing for various constructions.

snippet.title: Minecraft Mob Hunt… But Our Size Is Random
snippet.description:
We played Mob Hunt in Minecraft, but our size kept changing at the worst possible times.

It was Al1, Walli, Esta, Tucker, and me trying to hide, hunt, and survive while constantly changing size throughout the round. One second you’re small enough to blend in perfectly, and the next you’re way too big to hide from anyone.

The game turned into a mess pretty quickly. Hiding spots stopped working, chasing people got harder, and nobody knew what size they were going to be next.

snippet.title: The Cryptic Symbology of DELTARUNE  //  Ink Theory pt. 1
snippet.description:
Within Deltarune are two stories: one concerning things like "characters", "drama", and "feelings"... and another that I've spent the last six months thinking about. THAT story is one of SYMBOLS. White pens, pointed tails, stars reflected in black water. The dark corners and jagged edges of a warm and fuzzy game. This video chronicles my attempt to delve the murky symbolic underworld at Deltarune's foundations, and map a network of connections between the weirdest of the weird in Deltarune's lore.

Who knows... maybe it'll lead to something interesting? Pay no attention to the "Ink Theory" in the title. I'm sure it won't be important.
